meta.title: English to Korean Voice Translator | IQ Translate
meta.description: Translate Korean to English or English to Korean by voice or text, in Hangul, with the translation read aloud. 186 languages, free to try, no sign-up.
meta.ogDescription: Speak or type in Korean or English and get an instant translation in Hangul, spoken aloud or written. Works both directions, free to try.

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and Korean.

items.q: Does it write Korean in Hangul, not romanized letters?
items.a: Yes, translations appear in proper Hangul script, ready to read or copy.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Korean back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak Korean into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Does it handle polite and casual Korean speech?
items.a: It aims for natural, commonly used phrasing suited to everyday conversations, whether you're chatting casually or need something more polite.
Yes, try it free without creating an account. Sign in with Google for more daily credits and saved history.

items.q: Do I need a Korean keyboard installed?
items.a: No, the app displays Hangul automatically — no separate keyboard or input method needed.

items.q: Can I hear how to pronounce the Korean translation?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.

finalCta.heading: Start your English to Korean
